name: afsos ki dandan ka kiya rizq falak ne

content.roman:
aaj ik aur baras biit gayā us ke baġhair
jis ke hote hue hote the zamāne mere
afsos ki dandāñ kā kiyā rizq falak ne
jin logoñ kī thī dar-ḳhur-e-aqd-e-guhar añgusht
kaafī hai nishānī tirā chhalle kā na denā
ḳhālī mujhe dikhlā ke ba-vaqt-e-safar añgusht
likhtā huuñ 'asad' sozish-e-dil se suḳhan-e-garm
tā rakh na sake koī mire harf par añgusht
jaatā huuñ jidhar sab kī uThe hai udhar añgusht
yak-dast jahāñ mujh se phirā hai magar añgusht
mizhgāñ kī mohabbat meñ jo añgusht-numā huuñ
lagtī hai mujhe tiir ke mānind har añgusht
har ġhuncha-e-gul sūrat-e-yak-qatra-e-ḳhūñ hai
dekhā hai kisū kā jo hinā-basta sar-e-añgusht
garmī hai zabāñ kī sabab-e-soḳhtan-e-jāñ
har sham' shahādat ko hai yaañ sar-basar añgusht
ḳhuuñ dil meñ jo mere nahīñ baaqī to 'ajab kyā
juuñ māhī-e-be-āb taḌaptī hai har añgusht
shoḳhī tirī kah detī hai ahvāl hamārā
rāz-e-dil-e-sad-pāra kī hai parda dar-e-añgusht
kis rutba meñ bārīkī-o-narmī hai ki juuñ gul
aatī nahīñ panja meñ bas is ke nazar añgusht
maiñ ulfat-e-mizhgāñ meñ jo añgusht numā huuñ
lagtī hai mujhe tiir ke mānind har añgusht
afsos ki dandan ka kiya rizq falak ne
jin logon ki thi dar-KHur-e-aqd-e-guhar angusht
kafi hai nishani tera chhalle ka na dena
KHali mujhe dikhla ke ba-waqt-e-safar angusht
likhta hun 'asad' sozish-e-dil se suKHan-e-garm
ta rakh na sake koi mere harf par angusht
jata hun jidhar sab ki uThe hai udhar angusht
yak-dast jahan mujh se phira hai magar angusht
mizhgan ki mohabbat mein jo angusht-numa hun
lagti hai mujhe tir ke manind har angusht
har ghuncha-e-gul surat-e-yak-qatra-e-KHun hai
dekha hai kisu ka jo hina-basta sar-e-angusht
garmi hai zaban ki sabab-e-soKHtan-e-jaan
har sham' shahadat ko hai yan sar-basar angusht
KHun dil mein jo mere nahin baqi to 'ajab kya
jun mahi-e-be-ab taDapti hai har angusht
shoKHi teri kah deti hai ahwal hamara
raaz-e-dil-e-sad-para ki hai parda dar-e-angusht
kis rutba mein bariki-o-narmi hai ki jun gul
aati nahin panja mein bas is ke nazar angusht
main ulfat-e-mizhgan mein jo angusht numa hun
lagti hai mujhe tir ke manind har angusht
